name: lookout
description: Supervise the coding agents of one project running in herdr panes: discover them, route their questions to a supervisor session, answer what is reversible and escalate what is not; launch a batch of 3-tier pendientes, one agent each in its own herdr tab on the main checkout (a worktree only if the user asks), with idempotent prompt delivery; enforce goalspec governance before a push, publish in order, close pendientes by journal and relieve agents; approve trivial tool permissions of the executors once, by rules the user activated (manual mode only), and send the rest to the user.
